 HERE @ HOME: Medicare Open Enrollment special 
 Experts from Local Office on Aging and Better Business Bureau Serving Western Virginia among panel answering viewer questions about Medicare changes 
 Medicare Open Enrollment: Advice for choosing the right plan for you (MGN (Custom credit) | MGN Image (Credit)) By Kimberly McBroom Published : Oct. 19, 2026 at 9:00 AM EDT | Updated : 3 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google ROANOKE, Va. (WDBJ) - Medicare Open Enrollment runs Oct. 15 through Dec. 7, and WDBJ7’s Here @ Home hosted a special to help seniors navigate pricing questions and confusion.
 The Local Office on Aging in Roanoke offers free, confidential and unbiased counseling through the Virginia Insurance Counseling and Assistance Program, or VICAP, to educate, counsel and assist seniors.
 The Better Business Bureau warns scams spike during open enrollment. Watch for phony representatives who call, text or email out of the blue claiming to be from Medicare and asking to “verify” your Medicare or Social Security number to keep coverage active, and for offers promising lower costs, free services or exclusive plans as bait to steal personal information.
 Free VICAP counseling details: Oct. 15-Dec. 7, 2026, Monday-Thursday, 11 a.m.-3 p.m. Closed Fridays, major holidays and the week of Thanksgiving.
 The Local Office on Aging Off-site Counseling Center is located at Valley View Mall, upper level outside the former Sears space. It offers free and confidential for adults 60 and older. 
 Call (540) 345-0451 or email info@loaa.org .
